title: Bounded-above model for the union direct image
statement: Let p:Y→B be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes, let B and A be affine schemes, let g:A→B, and let U,V be opens of Y. Let N be a quasi-coherent module on U∪V flat over B. Assume StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen(p,g,T) for T=U,V,U∩V [def-pc-standard-single-flat-counit-presentation-on-open]. Using the standard derived categories of module sheaves, there exist a complex K of module sheaves on B, an integer b with K^i=0 for i>b, and an isomorphism R((U∪V)→B)_*(N[0])≅Q(K). No termwise flatness, pullback comparison or counit equation is asserted.

proof.text: For T=U,V,U intersection V, set a:T→U union V to Scheme.homOfLE. Compare tensorPullback a with exact open restriction by uniqueness of left adjoints to pushforward. Quasi-coherence transports across that isomorphism. Prove relative flatness of restriction directly: an affine open of T maps isomorphically onto an affine open of U union V; apply the affine-pair definition of IsFlatOver there. Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE and appLE_appIso_inv identify the scalar actions. Transport flatness along the section-module isomorphism. Thus hPU,hPV,hPUV give the three StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation witnesses.

Extract the complex K, integer b and base direct-image isomorphism from each presentation; discard its flatness, pullback and counit data. The termwise bound gives K.IsStrictlyLE b by CochainComplex.isStrictlyLE_iff, hence Q(K).IsLE b. Transport along quotientCompQhIso and the supplied isomorphism. Each of the three restricted direct images belongs to the bounded-above object property DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus.

Specialize standardSingle_union_ses_presentation to identity base change on B. Use only its first short exact row S and its three source-vertex identifications. The identity isomorphism from exists_derivedPullbackComposition identifies L(id_B)^* with the identity functor. Consequently Q(S.X2) is bounded above, since it identifies with a biproduct of the two bounded-above member direct images; Q(S.X3) is bounded above by the overlap presentation. The split biproduct distinguished triangle and ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₂ prove biproduct closure. Apply Mathlib DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES_distinguished to S and ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₁ for t.minus to deduce that Q(S.X1) is bounded above. Transport its bound through the first-vertex isomorphism and the identity pullback comparison to the union direct image.

Extract b and IsLE b from membership in t.minus. Mathlib DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isLE supplies a complex K with K.IsStrictlyLE b and an isomorphism from the union direct image to Q(K). CochainComplex.isZero_of_isStrictlyLE supplies the required termwise bound. Compose with the inverse of quotientCompQhIso to obtain exactly the requested Qh(quotient K) representative.

lean.statement: theorem exists_boundedAbove_union_model {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p] [IsAffine B] [IsAffine A] (g : A ⟶ B) (U V : Y.Opens) (N : (U ⊔ V).toScheme.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent] (hN : N.IsFlatOver ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p)) (hPU : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g U) (hPV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g V) (hPUV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g (U ⊓ V)) : letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard A.Modules letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard B.Modules ∃ K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings B.toRingedSpace)) ℤ, (∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧ Nonempty (((schemeDerivedDirectImage ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p)).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N) ≅ DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj K)))
